name: Supersegment Search with Spatial Smoothness
aliases: Finding the first supersegment on a ray
definition: An algorithm to find the first supersegment intersected in a list $\mathbb{L}_i$ by leveraging spatial smoothness (neighboring lists have similar supersegment sizes) to minimize memory accesses via adjacency search and binary search fallback.
summary: Supersegment Search with Spatial Smoothness is an optimized algorithm that finds the first intersected supersegment by using the previous frame's index as a spatial coherence seed, reducing memory accesses and improving frame rates over standard binary or linear search.
